definition_en: a small jumping animal that lives near water

definition_en: starting at, coming out of, because of, or made out of
core_image: 一条线从远处的一点连到眼前
scene: 她来自一座南方的小城。She comes from a small town in the south.

definition_en: white ice crystals on cold surfaces, or freezing weather
core_image: 清晨的草叶上结着细细的白霜
scene: 清晨的草地上覆着一层白霜。A layer of frost covered the grass in the morning.
sceneCN: 这里 frost 是「霜」（第 1 个义项）；句意：清晨的草地上覆着一层白霜。

senses.title: White ice crystals
senses.definition: thin white ice that forms on cold surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 在寒冷表面形成的薄白冰晶
senses.example: A layer of frost covered the grass in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 清晨的草地上覆着一层白霜。
senses.why: This is the basic weather sense.

senses.title: Freezing weather
senses.definition: a period of weather cold enough to damage plants
senses.definitionCN: 冷到足以冻坏植物的天气时段
senses.example: An early frost ruined the young shoots.
senses.exampleCN: 一场早霜毁了嫩芽。
senses.why: The white crystals stand for the cold that makes them.
senses.whyCN: 白霜代指造成它的寒冷。

senses.title: Icing on a cake
senses.definition: a sweet coating on baked food
senses.definitionCN: 烘焙食品表面的甜涂层
senses.example: The cake was covered with white frosting.
senses.exampleCN: 蛋糕上覆着一层白糖霜。
senses.why: The white coating looks like frost on a cold surface.
senses.whyCN: 白色涂层看起来像冷面上的霜。

abstract.en: What freezes overnight can melt by noon.
abstract.cn: 一夜冻结之物，正午便可融化。

core.en: Cold made white on a surface.
core.cn: 寒冷在表面上凝成的白色。

branches.en: Grass wears a thin white coat.

branches.cn: 冰晶与造成它的寒冷共用一个名称。

definition_en: to pull your eyebrows together, showing displeasure or deep thought
core_image: 老师皱着眉低头看作业本
scene: 老师看着乱糟糟的作业本，皱起了眉头。The teacher frowned at the messy exercise book.
sceneCN: 这里 frown 是「皱眉」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师看着乱糟糟的作业本，皱起了眉头。

senses.title: Pull the brows together
senses.definition: to move your eyebrows together because you are angry, worried, or thinking hard
senses.definitionCN: 因生气、担忧或苦苦思索而把眉毛皱在一起
senses.example: The teacher frowned at the messy exercise book.
senses.exampleCN: 老师看着乱糟糟的作业本，皱起了眉头。
senses.why: This is the basic facial action the word names.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词所指的基本面部动作。

senses.title: Show disapproval
senses.definition: to disapprove of something, often used with on or upon
senses.definitionCN: 不赞成某事，常与 on 或 upon 连用
senses.example: Many parents frown on late-night phone use.
senses.exampleCN: 许多家长不赞成深夜玩手机。
senses.why: A frown signals that something is not acceptable.
senses.whyCN: 皱眉表示某事不被接受。

senses.title: The frown itself
senses.definition: an expression in which the brows are pulled tightly together
senses.definitionCN: 双眉紧锁的表情
senses.example: A deep frown crossed his face.
senses.exampleCN: 他脸上掠过一道深深的皱眉。
senses.why: The action can also be named as a thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个动作也可以作为一个名词来称呼。

normal.cn: 他们去年合作富有成果。

normal.en: The rain made the valley fruitful.
normal.cn: 雨水让山谷变得多产。

abstract.en: A fruitful mind plants ideas that others can harvest.
abstract.cn: 富有成效的头脑种下别人也能收获的想法。

abstract.en: Time used well is always fruitful.
abstract.cn: 善加利用的时间总是有收获的。

abstract.en: Good questions make a meeting fruitful.
abstract.cn: 好的问题让会议富有成效。

examples.en: The discussion was very fruitful.
examples.cn: 那次讨论非常富有成效。

examples.en: The old apple tree is still fruitful.
examples.cn: 那棵老苹果树仍然果实累累。

examples.en: She had a fruitful career as a writer.
examples.cn: 她的写作生涯硕果累累。

dict_mnemonic.text: fruitful = fruit（果实）+ -ful（充满）；由「结满果实」引申为「富有成效」，与 fruitless（徒劳的）相对。

root: 由 fruit 加后缀 -ful（充满……的）构成；核心义「果实满满的」，引申为「成效丰硕」。

sensesIntro.en: Fruitful describes heavy branches, good results, or a productive life of work.
sensesIntro.cn: fruitful 形容果实压枝、结果良好，或创作多产。

core.en: Full of fruit, and therefore full of results.
core.cn: 结满果实，因而也成果丰硕。

branches.en: A talk yields useful decisions.
branches.cn: 一次谈话产生有用的决定。

branches.en: Branches bend under heavy fruit.
branches.cn: 枝条被沉甸甸的果实压弯。

branches.en: A writer's years produce many works.
branches.cn: 作家的岁月产生许多作品。

branches.en: Harvest and creative output share one image.
branches.cn: 收获与创作产出共享同一个意象。

branches.en: Good soil rewards patient care.
branches.cn: 好土壤回报耐心的照料。

intro.en: Fruitful shows how -ful turns a noun into a rich adjective.
intro.cn: fruitful 展示了 -ful 如何把名词变成含义丰富的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The suffix is Germanic; the root fruit came through French.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀属日耳曼语；词根 fruit 经法语传入。

items.meaningCN: 果实累累的；富有成效的

items.exampleCN: 他们一起工作卓有成效。

items.example: The fruitfulness of the soil surprised them.
items.exampleCN: 土地的肥沃让他们惊讶。
我们进行了一次富有成效的讨论。

items.example: The river made the land fruitful.
It was a fruitful year for the team.
items.exampleCN: 对团队来说那是成果丰硕的一年。
实验室做了富有成效的研究。

definition_en: to make someone feel annoyed or to prevent a plan from succeeding
core_image: 年轻的工程师对着失败的实验装置叹气
scene: 一次又一次的失败让这位年轻的工程师感到挫败。Repeated failures frustrated the young engineer.
sceneCN: 这里 frustrate 是「使感到挫败」（第 1 个义项）；句意：一次又一次的失败让这位年轻的工程师感到挫败。

senses.title: Make someone feel blocked
senses.definition: to make someone feel annoyed because they cannot succeed
senses.definitionCN: 使人因无法成功而感到恼火
senses.example: Repeated failures frustrated the young engineer.
senses.exampleCN: 一次又一次的失败让这位年轻的工程师感到挫败。
senses.why: This is the feeling sense most learners meet first.
senses.whyCN: 这是学习者最先接触的情绪义项。

senses.title: Block a plan
senses.definition: to prevent a plan or effort from succeeding
senses.definitionCN: 阻止计划或努力取得成功
senses.example: Bad weather frustrated their plans for a picnic.
senses.exampleCN: 坏天气打乱了他们野餐的计划。
senses.why: Here the object is a plan, not a person.
senses.whyCN: 这里宾语是计划，而不是人。

senses.title: Make hopes fail
senses.definition: to make someone's hopes or expectations fail
senses.definitionCN: 使某人的希望或期待落空
senses.example: The long delay frustrated her hopes of winning.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的延误使她获胜的希望落空。
senses.why: Hopes can be blocked just like plans.
senses.whyCN: 希望也会像计划一样被阻挠。

intro.en: Frustrate goes back to a Latin word for vain effort.
intro.cn: frustrate 可追溯到拉丁语中表示徒劳的词。

items.en: Frustra meant in vain.
items.cn: frustra 意为徒劳。

items.en: Frustrari meant to deceive or disappoint.
items.cn: frustrari 意为欺骗或使失望。

items.en: Frustratus became its past participle.
items.cn: frustratus 成为它的过去分词。

items.en: The verb entered English as frustrate.
items.cn: 这个动词以 frustrate 进入英语。

items.en: It now covers feelings, plans, and hopes.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖情绪、计划和希望。

note.en: Frustrate is compared with look-alike words and words for blocking.
note.cn: 把 frustrate 与形近词以及表示阻挠的词作比较。

a cone with the top cut off

normalIntro.en: Frustrate is the wall between effort and success.
normalIntro.cn: frustrate 是努力与成功之间的那堵墙。

normal.en: Repeated failures frustrated the young engineer.
normal.cn: 一次又一次的失败让年轻的工程师感到挫败。

normal.en: Bad weather frustrated their plans for a picnic.
normal.cn: 坏天气打乱了他们野餐的计划。

normal.en: The long delay frustrated her hopes of winning.
normal.cn: 漫长的延误使她获胜的希望落空。

normal.en: Slow traffic frustrates drivers every morning.
normal.cn: 缓慢的交通每天早晨都让司机沮丧。

normal.en: He felt frustrated by the endless rules.
normal.cn: 他被没完没了的规则弄得灰心。

abstract.en: Frustration is energy that has found no door.
abstract.cn: 挫败感是找不到出口的能量。

abstract.en: A blocked plan can teach a better route.
abstract.cn: 被阻挠的计划能教人找到更好的路线。

abstract.en: What frustrates us today may sharpen us tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 今天让我们受挫的事，明天也许让我们更锋利。

examples.en: Repeated failures frustrated the young engineer.
examples.cn: 一次又一次的失败让年轻的工程师感到挫败。

examples.en: Bad weather frustrated their plans for a picnic.
examples.cn: 坏天气打乱了他们野餐的计划。

examples.en: The long delay frustrated her hopes of winning.
examples.cn: 漫长的延误使她获胜的希望落空。

dict_mnemonic.text: frustrate 与 illustrate 形近，注意前缀不同；frustration 是「挫败感」，frustrating 是「令人沮丧的」。

root: 源自拉丁语 frustrari（使失望、使徒劳），词根 frustra 意为「徒劳」；核心义「使努力落空」。

sensesIntro.en: Frustrate covers making people annoyed, blocking plans, and dashing hopes.
sensesIntro.cn: frustrate 涵盖使人恼火、阻挠计划以及使希望落空。

core.en: Effort meets a wall and cannot pass.
core.cn: 努力撞上一堵墙，无法通过。

branches.en: A person feels stuck and annoyed.
branches.cn: 一个人感到受阻而恼火。

branches.en: A plan meets an obstacle.
branches.cn: 计划遇到障碍。

branches.en: A hope fades before it is reached.
branches.cn: 希望在到达之前消退。

branches.en: Blocked plans produce blocked feelings.
branches.cn: 受阻的计划产生受阻的情绪。

branches.en: Plans and hopes fail in the same way.
branches.cn: 计划与希望以同样的方式失败。

intro.en: Frustrate forms words about blocked effort and its feelings.
intro.cn: frustrate 构成一族表示受阻努力及其情绪的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base frustr- means in vain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 frustr- 意为徒劳。

items.example: The noise frustrates the whole class.
She looked frustrated after the test.
items.exampleCN: 考试后她看上去很沮丧。
雨水使他们的努力受挫。

items.example: The strike frustrated our travel plans.
items.exampleCN: 罢工打乱了我们的旅行计划。

items.example: Losing the file was a frustrating experience.
items.exampleCN: 丢失文件是一段令人沮丧的经历。

definition_en: to cook food in hot oil, or potato sticks cooked this way
core_image: 鸡蛋在热油平底锅里滋滋作响
scene: 她在热油里煎了一个鸡蛋。She fried an egg in hot oil.
sceneCN: 这里 fry 是「用油煎炸」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她在热油里煎了一个鸡蛋。

senses.title: Cook in hot oil
senses.definition: to cook food in a small amount of hot oil
senses.definitionCN: 用少量热油烹调食物
senses.example: She fried an egg in hot oil.
senses.exampleCN: 她在热油里煎了一个鸡蛋。
senses.why: This is the basic kitchen sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的厨房义项。

senses.title: Toss in a hot pan
senses.definition: to cook small pieces of food quickly in hot oil while moving them
senses.definitionCN: 在热油中快速翻动小块食物
senses.example: He fried the rice with vegetables.
senses.exampleCN: 他把米饭和蔬菜一起炒。
senses.why: Stir-frying is a fast, moving kind of frying.
senses.whyCN: 快炒是一种快速、不断翻动的煎炒。

senses.title: The potato sticks
senses.definition: thin pieces of potato cooked in hot oil, usually called fries
senses.definitionCN: 在热油中炸成的细条土豆，通常用复数 fries
senses.example: We ordered burgers and fries.
senses.exampleCN: 我们点了汉堡和炸薯条。
senses.why: The result of frying became a noun of its own.
senses.whyCN: 煎炸的结果本身成了一个名词。

intro.en: Fry came to English from Latin through French.
intro.cn: fry 由拉丁语经法语传入英语。

items.en: Frigere meant to roast or fry.
items.cn: frigere 意为烘烤或煎炸。

items.en: Frire carried the cooking sense.
items.cn: frire 保留了烹饪义。

items.en: The verb appeared as frien.
items.cn: 这个动词以 frien 的形式出现。

items.en: The spelling settled as fry.
items.cn: 拼写最终定型为 fry。

items.en: The plural fries named potato sticks.
items.cn: 复数 fries 用来指炸薯条。

note.en: Fry is compared with look-alike words and other cooking verbs.
note.cn: 把 fry 与形近词以及其他烹饪动词作比较。

entries.definition: to become worn at the edges
to fry quickly in a little oil
to cook in an oven or over fire

normalIntro.en: Fry is the sound of food meeting hot oil.
normalIntro.cn: fry 是食物碰上热油时的声音。

normal.en: She fried an egg in hot oil.
normal.cn: 她在热油里煎了一个鸡蛋。

normal.en: He fried the rice with vegetables.
normal.cn: 他把米饭和蔬菜一起炒。

normal.en: We ordered burgers and fries.
normal.cn: 我们点了汉堡和炸薯条。

normal.en: The chips are frying in the pan.
normal.cn: 薯条正在锅里炸着。

normal.en: Do not fry the fish for too long.
normal.cn: 鱼不要煎太久。

abstract.en: Frying is patience in a hot minute.
abstract.cn: 煎炸是在滚烫的一分钟里的耐心。

abstract.en: The same heat can burn or cook; timing decides.
abstract.cn: 同样的热度能烧焦也能煮熟，时机决定一切。

abstract.en: A simple egg teaches control of fire.
abstract.cn: 一个简单的鸡蛋教会人掌控火候。

examples.en: She fried an egg in hot oil.
examples.cn: 她在热油里煎了一个鸡蛋。

examples.en: He fried the rice with vegetables.
examples.cn: 他把米饭和蔬菜一起炒。

examples.en: We ordered burgers and fries.
examples.cn: 我们点了汉堡和炸薯条。

dict_mnemonic.text: fry 与 fly 只差一个字母；fries 常指「炸薯条」，stir-fry 是「快炒」，frying pan 是「煎锅」。

root: 源自拉丁语 frigere（煎炸、烘烤），经古法语 frire 进入英语；核心义「用热油加热食物」。

sensesIntro.en: Fry means cooking in hot oil, quick stir-frying, or the fries that result.
sensesIntro.cn: fry 指用热油煎炸、快速翻炒，或由此炸成的薯条。

core.en: Food meets hot oil and quickly cooks.
core.cn: 食物遇上热油并迅速变熟。

branches.en: An egg firms up in shallow oil.
branches.cn: 鸡蛋在浅油中凝固。

branches.en: Rice and vegetables dance in the pan.
branches.cn: 米饭和蔬菜在锅里翻动。

branches.en: Potato sticks turn golden and crisp.
branches.cn: 土豆条变得金黄酥脆。

branches.en: Both methods use heat and oil.
branches.cn: 两种方法都用热和油。

branches.en: The cooked result takes a name of its own.
branches.cn: 烹调的结果有了自己的名称。

intro.en: Fry builds words for cooking and for fried foods.
intro.cn: fry 构成表示烹饪和油炸食品的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base frig- means to roast or fry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 frig- 意为烘烤或煎炸。
